evidence.note: Genuine environment probing before building: checks python3/node/npm presence and versions, tests `import aiohttp, aiosqlite`, greps `pip list` for web frameworks, then `pip install`s missing deps. This confirms the runtime/framework/deps constraint (anchor-5 behavior). No check for Chromium/browser or port availability though.

Plans enumerate the full subsystem surface from the spec (auth, profiles, workspaces, channels, messages, threads, reactions, dms, files, search, slash commands, mentions, read state, groups, invitations, ws, irc) — showing the spec was mined for breadth of contracts per subsystem rather than a vague 'Slack clone'.

Explicitly references the data-testid requirements and enumerates specific UI hooks (auth-form, three-pane, hover-toolbar, emoji picker, thread panel) to satisfy the pinned selector list — evidence of extracting the frontend contract.

Designs the broker/fallback specifically against the resilience requirement (broker-kill → fall back to DB polling, reconnect on return), showing the resilience window contract was read and reflected in design.

No sign of a distilled, referenced contract inventory of exact status codes (409/423/413), IRC numerics, WS frame kinds, or the subtle traps (transfer_ownership vs PATCH-to-owner, member_user_ids naming, non-member mention exclusion, resume.gap, node_id 0/1/2 indexing). Contract handling appears embedded in coding rather than surfaced/cross-referenced.

reasoning: The agent probes the runtime before building (confirms Python/Node, tests and installs aiohttp/aiosqlite) and extracts the main contracts per subsystem, enumerating the full feature surface and acknowledging the testid list and resilience/broker semantics — matching the anchor-5 description of confirming the runtime and catching the main contracts. However, the visible trajectory shows no systematic contract inventory of exact status codes, IRC numerics, WS frame kinds or seq invariants, and never surfaces the subtle traps (transfer-ownership vs PATCH, guest/member gating, non-member mention exclusion, resume.gap, node_id indexing) that define the anchor-8 level, nor does it revisit the spec to resolve under-specified points. This places it solidly at 5.
